dashboard.label: TA-patch Overview
dashboard.description: Collects patch compliance: upgradable package count (security vs total where distinguishable), days since the last successful apt/dnf transaction (from package-manager history

search.query: index=main sourcetype="patch:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="patch.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="patch:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
